answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 58 epochs. Receipts are issued in nectar, burned on slash in wander, and listed in pigment. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 29 times costs 13 separate deposits and 58 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
